name: Clash Weapon Lock
description: Template: plays while both actors are locked together in a standoff. Put replacement block animations here (for example 1hm_blockidle.hkx, 2hm_blockidle.hkx, 2hw_blockidle.hkx, 1hm_blockstart.hkx ...) to swap the calm block hold for a strained weapon lock. Without any .hkx files this folder does nothing.
